label: GO step near the end of the episode (trial >= ~93), ramping toward trial 99
explanation: An episode-clock / end-of-episode feature. It never fires before episode trial 80, and 99.6% of its activation mass falls in trials 90-99. 95% of the mass is at GO steps, a little is at D1, and none is at D2. It ramps up within that range: the onset is soft around trials 90-93, it is already active on almost every GO step from trial ~95 on, and at trials 98-99 GO precision is 0.99. The top activations come from the last trials, and windows show it rising steadily from trial to trial. It does not depend on choice, state, transition, reward, stay/switch or the good state; all lifts are about 1x. It tracks the value head being low (all activity is in the lowest value bin, value < 5.22), which matches the expected reward left in the episode running out. It is somewhat weaker when the policy is uncertain (|choice| small), but conditioning on that did not improve F1. Rare D1 activations (penalty or d1_err trials, late D1 steps) are a minor extra. The threshold ep_trial >= 93 is the best F1 on dev (0.77, mass recall 0.90). Verdict is partial because the onset is graded and the predicate is a time/phase position; the information is in the magnitude (episode progress).
